education.summary: A learning platform that brings lessons, quizzes and student progress together for students, parents and teachers.
education.challenge: The academy ran its lessons through WhatsApp groups and scattered files. Students missed lessons, parents couldn't follow progress, and teachers spent hours marking quizzes by hand.
education.solution: We designed one platform for everyone: students follow lessons in order and take auto-marked quizzes, parents get a clear weekly report, and teachers upload content from a simple dashboard.

results.label: active students in the first term

ecommerce.summary: An online store for a local fashion label, with an elegant, fast buying experience on mobile.
ecommerce.challenge: All sales went through Instagram DMs and orders were logged by hand, so orders got lost, replies were slow and nobody knew which products sold best.
ecommerce.solution: We built a store that carries the brand's feel: large photography, easy browsing by collection and a two-step checkout, connected to the courier and inventory so everything updates on its own.
features: Two-step checkout with mada and Apple Pay

clinic.summary: An appointment system that lets patients book in under a minute and takes pressure off the front desk.
clinic.challenge: Every booking came by phone, so lines were busy at peak times, and many appointments were missed because there were no reminders.
clinic.solution: We designed a booking system that shows doctors and open slots live, sends a reminder before each visit with one-tap cancel or reschedule, and gives reception a clear view of the day.

delivery.summary: A delivery app for restaurants and shops, with live courier tracking on the map.
delivery.challenge: The client wanted to enter the delivery market quickly with an app that could stand next to the big players, on a limited budget and timeline.
delivery.solution: We built three connected parts: the customer app, the courier app and an admin panel, with a simple ordering flow and live tracking that keeps customers reassured until their order arrives.

dashboard.summary: A dashboard for a shipping company that shows shipments, reports and performance on one clear screen.
dashboard.challenge: Data lived in several systems and Excel sheets, management needed days to prepare a weekly report, and nobody had a live view of shipments.
dashboard.solution: We brought the data into one live dashboard: a shipments map, clear KPIs, alerts for delayed shipments and one-click report exports.

restaurant.summary: A website and digital menu for a restaurant, with QR codes on the tables and direct ordering.
restaurant.challenge: Paper menus wore out and were hard to reprice, and the restaurant had no clear online presence to show its dishes and take orders.
restaurant.solution: We designed a warm site that reflects the restaurant, a digital menu the staff update themselves, and a QR code on every table that opens the menu with ordering built in.
